sources.title: Fertility treatment 2024: trends and figures
sources.note: published 16 June 2026 from a register snapshot of 6 May 2026; 64,000 patients and over 100,000 treatment and freezing cycles in 2024; average IVF birth rate per embryo transferred 30%, 38% at ages 18-34 and 8% at 43-44; 2024 birth outcomes marked preliminary

sources.title: Fertility treatment 2024: quality and methodology report
sources.note: people are in the Register 'regardless of a person's residence'; 'We do not hold detailed information on partner intrauterine insemination (IUI), or treatments that takes place outside of licensed clinics'; regions are assigned 'based on the location of the clinic rather than patient's residency'; the Register runs since 1991 and is described as the longest running database of fertility treatment in the world

sources.note: 'The Fertility Clinic Success Rate and Certification Act of 1992 mandates that clinics performing ART annually provide data to CDC'; 'A small number of clinics do not report data to CDC and are listed as nonreporters'; NASS estimated to contain about 98% of all US ART cycles

sources.title: About assisted reproductive technology

sources.note: ART covers treatments in which eggs or embryos are handled; 'ART does NOT include treatments in which only sperm are handled (such as intrauterine insemination)'

sources.title: Organ trafficking and transplant tourism and commercialism: the Declaration of Istanbul
sources.note: read in full from the custodian group's PDF: the summit ran in Istanbul 'from April 30 to May 1, 2008', convened by The Transplantation Society and the International Society of Nephrology; 152 participants from 78 countries; the panel carries the 2008 definitions of organ trafficking, transplant commercialism and travel for transplantation/transplant tourism; also the WHO 10% estimate attributed to a personal communication, and two-thirds of Pakistan's 2,000 kidney transplants going to foreign recipients by 2006

sources.title: The Declaration — 2018 edition

sources.title: 2020: worst year in tourism history with 1 billion fewer international arrivals
sources.note: arrivals down 74% in 2020, 1 billion fewer than 2019, an estimated USD 1.3 trillion in lost export revenues, 100-120 million direct tourism jobs at risk; Asia-Pacific -84%, Middle East and Africa -75%, Europe -70%, Americas -69%

sources.title: Elective surgery cancellations due to the COVID-19 pandemic: global predictive modelling to inform surgical recovery plans
sources.publisher: British Journal of Surgery 2020;107(11):1440-1449 (COVIDSurg Collaborative), doi:10.1002/bjs.11746
sources.note: a projection, not a count: 28,404,603 operations cancelled or postponed over 12 peak weeks, 2,367,050 a week, a 72.3% cancellation rate, 81.7% of benign-condition operations, 37.7% of cancer operations, 25.4% of elective caesarean sections; built from a global expert response study fed through a model
